_comment: Phase 4 model version registry. Read/validated by predictivesense/models/registry.py. Activation is a deliberate operation - there is no code that flips 'active'; a human edits this file. No model has been trained: v1 is the pre-exported Phase 2 detector + pose (Ultralytics YOLO11n ONNX). The .onnx files themselves are git-ignored (see models/manifest.json / .gitignore); only their SHA-256s are tracked here and must match models/manifest.json.

models.name: baseline-yolo11n
models.source: Ultralytics YOLO11n / YOLO11n-pose, pre-exported ONNX (github.com/ultralytics/assets v8.3.0). Fetched + SHA-256-verified by scripts/fetch_models.py.
models.notes: Baseline. Phase 2.5 evaluation harness output at metrics_ref is PENDING the developer's val labels (data/eval is unlabelled as of Phase 4); see docs/phase-reports/phase2_5.md and docs/attribution.md. Recognition is unchanged by Phase 4.
